items.text: Individuals should prioritize their personal goals over group goals.
People should put the needs of their group ahead of their own.
Personal autonomy is more important than group harmony.
Group harmony should be valued over individual preferences.
People should be free to choose their own path even if it conflicts with group expectations.
Loyalty to one’s community should guide personal decisions.
Self-reliance is more valuable than dependence on a group.
A person’s identity is primarily defined by their relationships and group ties.
